## About Rb Diversified Private Limited

Data last updated: 08 March 2026

Rb Diversified Private Limited is a private limited company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It specialises in brokerage and trading services, a part of the broader financial services sector. Incorporated on 20 June 2006, the company has been in operation for over 20 years.

Registered with ROC Mumbai under CIN U74120MH2006PTC273542.

Capital: an authorised share capital of ₹6.17 Cr and a paid-up capital of ₹23.76 Lakh. Formerly known as Rb Investments Private Limited. It is led by directors including Mohan Lal Jain and Vandana Malik.

Last AGM: 30 September 2025. Financial statements filed for year ended 31 March 2025. Office: 301/401 Aquamarine Plot Number 273 – B Carter Road Bandra West, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India – 400050.

As per the financials filed for FY 2025, the company reported a revenue of ₹55.59 Cr, a growth of 111% compared to the previous year.

Its group structure includes 3 subsidiaries.

The company is associated with 1 brand - The Quint. As per MCA filings, the company has open charges of ₹601.35 Cr and satisfied charges of ₹155.64 Cr on record.

The current compliance status is marked as compliant by the Registrar of Companies.
